orange.name: Orange
orange.description: Long reach and a two-sided air sweep. Spin clears space, but a missed swing leaves a real opening.
orange.head: double_ring

red.name: Red
red.description: The hardest basic hit and a crushing air drop. Slow feet and windup reward careful timing.
red.head: tilted

green.name: Green
green.description: Fastest feet and blade; lighter hits need precise spacing. Jump + attack lunges diagonally.
green.head: oval

blue.name: Blue
blue.description: A solid pick and upward air hook catch jumpers. Shorter reach and slower feet call for timing.
blue.head: round

purple.name: Purple
purple.tagline: One bright arrow. A very clear message.
purple.description: Arrows rule at range; close pressure is risky. Face a shot and time dodge to shield or reflect it, then counter.
purple.head: round

yellow.name: Yellow
yellow.tagline: Quick feet. Short staff. Lots of helpers.
yellow.description: Quick footwork and a short staff reward close timing. Jump + attack dives; Swarm pressures from afar.
yellow.head: round

pac_man.name: Pac-Man
pac_man.tagline: A hungry gatekeeper with a giant grin.
pac_man.description: Watch the mouth. Jump over the charged dash, then strike during the rest.
pac_man.head: chomp

dark_lord.name: Dark lord
dark_lord.tagline: The last doodle in the machine.
dark_lord.description: Watch the windup. Dodge the camera marks.
dark_lord.head: crown

h4ck3r.name: H4CK3R
h4ck3r.description: Sidestep the cursor. Jump the ink. Strike while his screen reboots.
h4ck3r.head: monitor
